biw_news.title: Audi's Next A4 Delayed Until 2029 As VW's New EV Platform Falls Behind
biw_news.summary: Delays in Volkswagen Group's Scalable Systems Platform (SSP) defer the deployment of next-generation unified EV body-in-white architectures and structural battery integration across Audi's lineup. The platform delay impacts planned manufacturing efficiencies and multi-material lightweight structural designs tailored for high-volume EV production.

biw_news.title: For The First Time In Six Years, Ford Won't Win North American Truck Of The Year
biw_news.summary: Shifts in the 2027 NACTOY truck shortlist draw attention to competing body-on-frame structural innovations and body-in-white design approaches across major manufacturers. Structural optimizations using high-strength steel, aluminum cab enclosures, and optimized frame rails remain key differentiators in modern pickup architecture.

biw_news.title: Gas Prices Are Up, And So Are EV Sales
biw_news.summary: Accelerating electric vehicle adoption reinforces the industry transition toward dedicated EV body-in-white architectures engineered around structural battery integration and side-impact protection. These platform demands drive structural innovations in ultra-high-strength steel safety cages and large-scale aluminum castings.
